stage_table.PREPARED_LOCAL: plan frozen; files hashed; zero requests
stage_table.UPLOADING: dispatch started; per-file side effects recorded before each send
stage_table.UPLOADED_STAGING: every upload returned a receipt; no draft yet
stage_table.DRAFT_SAVED: draft accepted; still not a submission
stage_table.SUBMIT_SENT_UNVERIFIED: final submit sent; result not observed
stage_table.VERIFIED: an observed submission-v1 record proves the final submission
stage_table.UNKNOWN: a write response was lost or a remote result is not provable; read-only reconciliation
stage_table.FAILED: plan expiry, changed preconditions, definite not-sent or an observed remote failure

acceptance.case: the legacy prepare_submission uploads and submits nothing
acceptance.note: A transport that raises on send is attached; the legacy path returns submit_supported=false and never reaches it.

acceptance.case: a file edited after preview invalidates the plan even with the same name
acceptance.note: preflight re-hashes every file; the engine invalidates on the changed digest/checks with zero requests.

acceptance.case: a failure on the second upload keeps the first effect and the recovery state
acceptance.note: File 0 stays ACCEPTED with its receipt, file 1 is UNKNOWN, file 2 is PENDING, and later reads never upload again.

acceptance.case: a lost upload response is never replayed
acceptance.note: The remote keeps the stored staging upload; three result() polls leave the upload count unchanged.

acceptance.case: a saved draft is never reported as a submitted assignment
acceptance.note: DRAFT_SAVED and SUBMITTED-without-observation stay UNKNOWN; a SUBMITTED record requires is_final, result_observed and a remote id.

acceptance.case: an existing submission is not overwritten without replacement authorization
acceptance.note: REPLACE_EXISTING requires the exact version frozen at preview; a version change between preview and execute fails closed.

acceptance.case: a platform that returns only file names never proves hash equality
acceptance.note: identity_verified can be true while content_verified stays false with CONTENT_HASH_NOT_AVAILABLE in the limitations.

acceptance.case: local cancellation and code rollback never withdraw or resubmit
acceptance.note: cancel() reports remote_changes=NONE, there is no withdraw API, and result() performs no write.

security_summary.authorization: every plan needs a 4.4 host-authorization-v1 grant bound to the plan, account, business digest and adapter version; MCP arguments, page content and model output never create one
security_summary.request_gate: one exact ordered single-use RequestGate over at most ten requests; bodies are fully determined at preflight from client-derived references
security_summary.dispatch_intent: DISPATCHING, the ticket and the per-step SideEffectLedger entries are durable before the transport is called
security_summary.file_binding: only name/size/sha256 enter the business object; local paths stay in the protected module store; files are re-hashed in preflight and again before each upload
security_summary.storage: THU-SUBMISSION-FILES-1 and THU-SUBMISSION-STATE-1 use the same protect/unprotect as ActionStore (2.2 envelope or Windows DPAPI), atomic temp+fsync+replace, POSIX 0600; a configured key fails closed instead of falling back to the test codec
security_summary.no_production_path: only a transport that declares synthetic=true is accepted; every request URL uses the reserved /synthetic/ prefix so no real endpoint is guessed
security_summary.public_output: no local path, file content, note text or receipt value; only file names, sizes, hashes, statuses and the observed submission-v1 record
security_summary.replay: no automatic replay anywhere; lost responses leave UNKNOWN and only readback reconciliation follows

remaining_limits: No production transport exists: upload, draft-save, final-submit and result-query endpoints, their response shapes and the result query fields are unverified. That is the recorded blocker, not a hidden placeholder.
The synthetic transport and the /synthetic/ request paths are engineering evidence only; they are never live campus success and cannot be enabled by configuration.

Reconcile and preflight do not write to the action journal by design (a write would collide with the engine's captured revision), so per-precondition codes are visible only through a direct adapter.preflight() call or the module journal's last_error; the engine reports the generic PRECONDITIONS_CHANGED_PREPARE_AGAIN.

A platform rejection after a request was sent leaves the engine in UNKNOWN (the framework never marks FAILED after a send); the module records SUBMISSION_PLATFORM_REJECTED for the caller but does not claim the write did not happen.
File sets accumulate under submissions-v1/files; prune keeps the newest 200 and never removes one referenced by a live plan.

Withdrawing a draft, deleting a remote attachment and replacing an existing submission version are not implemented; only an explicit REPLACE_EXISTING plan with the exact replaced version is described.
The engine contract is registered with enabled=false (the write switch is module-owned) so describe_actions('learn') reports ADAPTER_REQUIRED until 6.1 wires the facade switch.
